# Golden compatibility fixtures

Encrypted databases produced by other SQLCipher implementations. Sealite must open every one
of them on every platform with the key and configuration listed here. The files are binary and
must never be regenerated casually: the salt is random, so a regenerated file has a different
hash. Regenerate only to add a new fixture, and update the table below.

## Contents (identical in every fixture)

```
CREATE TABLE notes(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, body BLOB);
```

| id | title             | body                                          |
|----|-------------------|-----------------------------------------------|
| 1  | `hello`           | 3 bytes `00 ff 10`                            |
| 2  | `Привіт, світ 🌍` | 4096 bytes, byte `i` = `i % 251`              |
| 3  | `empty body`      | empty blob (length 0, not NULL)               |

`PRAGMA user_version` = 7.

Keys:
- RAW = the 32 bytes `00 01 02 ... 1f`, given to SQLCipher as the raw-key literal
  `x'000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f'` (no passphrase KDF; the
  salt is read from the file header).
- PASS = the passphrase `correct horse battery staple` (UTF-8).

## Files

| File | Generator | SQLCipher | Key | Configuration | sha256 |
|------|-----------|-----------|-----|---------------|--------|
| `cli_raw_v4.db` | sqlcipher CLI | 4.20.0 community (CommonCrypto) | RAW | SQLCipher 4 defaults (page 4096, HMAC-SHA512, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 256000 for passphrases) | `47bfe4a80fdc9b29cc36b882cfc7d825816695a9d99d9b3377cef001381bfee4` |
| `cli_pass_v4.db` | sqlcipher CLI | 4.20.0 community | PASS | SQLCipher 4 defaults | `ae03a51554243887e261b6235873708d4ccfc4e4f2498918659ee96a39454467` |
| `cli_pass_v3.db` | sqlcipher CLI | 4.20.0 community | PASS | `PRAGMA cipher_compatibility = 3` (page 1024, HMAC-SHA1, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA1 64000). Opening it under v4 defaults must fail. | `f86013f4455df6c8959f3b1f05af27c603b540e1f6bdbb7fc8beedb53dfa6e7e` |
| `cli_raw_v4_wal.db` | sqlcipher CLI | 4.20.0 community | RAW | v4 defaults, `journal_mode = WAL` persisted in the header, checkpointed with `wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)` and closed: no `-wal` / `-shm` file accompanies it | `05ed2fc83d66c1d90146914568f683f198f4be062fa3faa1b0c39f7a1c7e8e15` |
| `zetetic_raw_v4.db` | `net.zetetic:sqlcipher-android:4.19.1` + `androidx.sqlite:sqlite:2.4.0` through `SupportOpenHelperFactory`, instrumented test on an Android 34 arm64 emulator | 4.19.0 community (as reported by `PRAGMA cipher_version` inside the library) | RAW, passed as the passphrase bytes = ASCII of the literal `x'<64 hex>'` | library defaults (v4); journal mode `delete`; schema created in `onCreate`, version 7 set by the open helper | `a65eb347c128dcbbb1a060da15d763c33be0409af4f5493c5b73ff6b478ea9b9` |

## Plaintext fixture

`plain_rich.db` is **not encrypted** and is the input of `Sealite.encryptPlaintext` tests, not a
compatibility fixture. Generated by `generate/plain_rich.sh` with the sqlcipher CLI (no key, so
plain SQLite format): 4096-byte pages, `auto_vacuum = INCREMENTAL`, `user_version` 5,
`application_id` 0x12345678, tables `item` and `audit` (both `AUTOINCREMENT`), indexes
`item_name` and `item_name_qty` (unique), view `item_big`, trigger `item_ai` (inserts a row into
`audit`), and three `item` rows (`apple`, `Привіт 🌍`, `cherry`) with three matching `audit` rows.
sha256 `de76e9e8a28815af33786a33a7185e57299744b7c82ff349c2e0f29e8e8770b7`.

## Generators (`generate/`)

- `cli_generate.sh <sqlcipher-cli> <out-dir>`: the four CLI fixtures. The CLI is the official
  SQLCipher 4.20.0 source (tarball sha256
  `38705f51b61ac0636a5fd064f9a77fafabc7227b2aa2513f1b14c8bb1102affc`) built on macOS with
  CommonCrypto:
  `./configure --with-tempstore=yes CFLAGS="-O2 -DSQLITE_HAS_CODEC -DSQLCIPHER_CRYPTO_CC -DSQLITE_EXTRA_INIT=sqlcipher_extra_init -DSQLITE_EXTRA_SHUTDOWN=sqlcipher_extra_shutdown" LDFLAGS="-framework Security -framework CoreFoundation" && make sqlite3`
  (the resulting binary is `sqlite3`, reporting `SQLCipher 4.20.0 community`).
- `zetetic-gen/`: throwaway Android project (Gradle 9.8 + AGP 9.4, `compileSdk` 36, needs
  `sdk.dir` in `local.properties`). `GenerateFixtureTest` writes `zetetic_raw_v4.db`. Run:
  `gradle :app:assembleDebug :app:assembleDebugAndroidTest`, install both APKs on an emulator,
  `adb shell am instrument -w -e class fixtures.gen.GenerateFixtureTest fixtures.gen.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner`,
  then `adb exec-out run-as fixtures.gen cat databases/zetetic_raw_v4.db > zetetic_raw_v4.db`.
- `verify.sh <sqlcipher-cli> <testdata-dir>`: opens each fixture with the CLI and checks rows,
  blob digest and `user_version`; also checks that a wrong key is rejected, that the v3 file is
  rejected under v4 defaults and that no file starts with the plaintext SQLite header.
